unresolved_requirements: No native DICOM, full acquired CT/MRI stacks, HU values, calibrated pixel spacing, original scanner orientation, source segmentation, source masks or patient-specific interactive meshes supplied.
The original Figure 2 A2/A4/A6 volume-rendered views are static publication artwork, not recoverable 3D surfaces.
Individual panel age/sex and publication-consent records were not independently verified. Mixed cohort ages do not establish pediatric exemplars.
No CT/MRI same-patient registration established; four MRI panels remain explicitly separate modality evidence. Separate 2025 TRACK-TBI/MGH study exemplars are not registered to CENTER-TBI.

Source-reported diagnoses, time intervals, calipers and estimates are retained as source claims. This review does not validate patient diagnoses, source caliper calibration, prognostic thresholds, institutional treatment protocols or complete anatomical boundaries.

2024 publisher lists 52 supplemental DOCX documents not acquired after HTTP 403; higher-resolution figure masters were not acquired or verified. This review covers the complete 14 numbered main figures in the acquired PDF, not all underlying source data or supplements.

Original JPEGs are 14 untagged DeviceCMYK/Adobe YCCK streams plus one DeviceGray stream. Chosen RGB conversion preserves geometry and declared renderer output, but is not exact original-channel identity, colorimetric calibration or HU fidelity.

Full clinical/commercial module readiness, all fine-structure obligations, and all image/schema/model correspondence remain unproven; every new source asset retains empty requirement coverage and pending anatomy review.

No authenticated app reader, deployment CDN/Blob delivery, runtime registry, speech controls, model synchronization, production database or clinical approval was tested or changed by this source-only review.
